name: rotlog
description: Fast rotating logger for Bun (Rust core via bun:ffi): rotation, gzip, Google Cloud Storage upload, request logging

scripts.build:native: cargo build --release --lib --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && bun -e "const { suffix } = require('bun:ffi'); const fs = require('fs'); const n = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'rotlog.dll' : 'librotlog.' + suffix; fs.mkdirSync('native', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('../../target/release/' + n, 'native/' + n); console.log('native/' + n);"
